blocks.en: Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle} states that $u$ assumes its maximum at the boundary. However, $u$ may assume its maximum at many points, and therefore the theorem does not rule out the possibility that some of these points are interior. The strong maximum principle states that this is impossible, unless $u$ is a constant. For the proof, we shall need the following lemma, which is interesting in its own right.
blocks.zh: Theorem~\ref{thm:weak-maximum-principle} 指出, $u$ 在边界上取得最大值. 然而, $u$ 可能在许多点取得最大值, 因而该定理并未排除其中一些点是内点的可能性. 强最大值原理指出, 除非 $u$ 为常数, 否则这种情况不可能发生. 为证明这一点, 需要以下引理, 它本身也很有意义.

blocks.en:
Suppose that $\Omega$ lies on one side of $\partial\Omega$. Assume $Lu\geq0$, and let $\bm{x}_0$ be a point on $\partial\Omega$ such that $u(\bm{x}_0)>u(\bm{x})$ for every $\bm{x}\in\Omega$. Also assume that, in a neighborhood of $\bm{x}_0$, $\partial\Omega$ is a $C^2$-surface and that $u$ is differentiable at $\bm{x}_0$. Moreover, suppose that either
\begin{enumerate}
\item $c=0$,
\item $c\leq0$ and $u(\bm{x}_0)\geq0$, or
\item $u(\bm{x}_0)=0$
\end{enumerate}
Then $\partial u/\partial n(\bm{x}_0)>0$, where $\partial u/\partial n$ denotes the derivative in the direction of the outer normal to $\partial\Omega$.
blocks.zh:
假设 $\Omega$ 位于 $\partial\Omega$ 的一侧. 假设 $Lu\geq0$, 并设 $\bm{x}_0$ 为 $\partial\Omega$ 上的一点, 使对每个 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 都有 $u(\bm{x}_0)>u(\bm{x})$. 再假设在 $\bm{x}_0$ 的一个邻域内, $\partial\Omega$ 是 $C^2$ 曲面, 且 $u$ 在 $\bm{x}_0$ 处可微. 此外, 假设以下情形之一成立:
\begin{enumerate}
\item $c=0$,
\item $c\leq0$ 且 $u(\bm{x}_0)\geq0$, 或
\item $u(\bm{x}_0)=0$
\end{enumerate}
那么 $\partial u/\partial n(\bm{x}_0)>0$, 其中 $\partial u/\partial n$ 表示沿 $\partial\Omega$ 的外法向的方向导数.
blocks.label: lem:elliptic-boundary-point

blocks.en: Since $\Omega$ is assumed to be connected, it can be shown that $\Omega$ lies on one side of $\partial\Omega$ if $\Omega$ is bounded and $\partial\Omega$ is globally smooth. (This is a multidimensional generalization of the Jordan curve theorem.) For a proof of this see, e.g.,~\cite{Mas}.
blocks.zh: 由于假设了 $\Omega$ 连通, 可以证明, 若 $\Omega$ 有界且 $\partial\Omega$ 整体光滑, 则 $\Omega$ 位于 $\partial\Omega$ 的一侧. (这是 Jordan 曲线定理的多维推广.) 证明可参见例如~\cite{Mas}.
blocks.label: rem:boundary-one-side-jordan

blocks.en: Assume $Lu\geq0$ ($Lu\leq0$) in $\Omega$ (not necessarily bounded) and assume that $u$ is not constant. If $c=0$, then $u$ does not achieve its maximum (minimum) in the interior of $\Omega$. If $c\leq0$, $u$ cannot achieve a non-negative maximum (non-positive minimum) in the interior. Regardless of the sign of $c$, $u$ cannot be zero at an interior maximum (minimum).
blocks.zh: 假设在 $\Omega$ (不一定有界) 内 $Lu\geq0$ ($Lu\leq0$), 并假设 $u$ 不为常数. 若 $c=0$, 则 $u$ 不在 $\Omega$ 内部达到最大值 (最小值). 若 $c\leq0$, 则 $u$ 不能在内部达到非负的最大值 (非正的最小值). 无论 $c$ 的符号如何, $u$ 都不能在内部的最大值 (最小值) 点处为零.
blocks.label: thm:strong-maximum-principle

blocks.en: Assume that $u$ assumes its maximum $M$ at an interior point and let $\Omega^-=\Omega\cap\{u<M\}$. If $\Omega^-$ is not empty, then $\partial\Omega^-\cap\Omega$ is not empty. Let $\bm{y}$ be a point in $\Omega^-$ that is closer to $\partial\Omega^-$ than to $\partial\Omega$ and let $B$ be the largest ball contained in $\Omega^-$ and centered at $\bm{y}$. Let $\bm{x}_0$ be a point on $\partial B\cap\partial\Omega^-$. Then we can apply the previous lemma to $B$. We conclude that $\nabla u$ is nonzero at $\bm{x}_0$, contradicting the assumption that $u$ assumes its maximum there.
blocks.zh: 假设 $u$ 在某内点取得最大值 $M$, 令 $\Omega^-=\Omega\cap\{u<M\}$. 若 $\Omega^-$ 非空, 则 $\partial\Omega^-\cap\Omega$ 非空. 设 $\bm{y}$ 是 $\Omega^-$ 中一点, 它到 $\partial\Omega^-$ 的距离小于到 $\partial\Omega$ 的距离, 并设 $B$ 为以 $\bm{y}$ 为球心且包含于 $\Omega^-$ 内的最大球. 取 $\bm{x}_0$ 为 $\partial B\cap\partial\Omega^-$ 上一点. 那么可以对 $B$ 应用前一个引理. 得到 $\nabla u$ 在 $\bm{x}_0$ 处非零, 与 $u$ 在那里取得最大值的假设矛盾.
